name: codex-session-sync
description: Safely synchronize local Codex tasks between official-login and API/custom providers.

scripts.check: node --check sync_codex_sessions.js && node --check lifecycle_health.js && python3 -m py_compile anyrouter_compat_proxy.py anyrouter_auth_helper.py install_anyrouter_compat.py
scripts.test: npm run check && python3 anyrouter_compat_proxy_test.py && python3 anyrouter_auth_helper_test.py && python3 install_anyrouter_compat_test.py && node lifecycle_health_test.js && node core_logic_test.js
